## Current execution adjustment: E -> D -> qualification

The partial implementation at `24ef187d4` does not complete Stages 3–4. Continue existing code through focused assignments; preserve every original acceptance criterion. A reserved format tag, a valid rebuilt mapping, or smoke timings do not establish the missing capability/proof.

- **E:** complete physical metadata pooling through real SQLite save/finish/reopen and exact canonical readback, including pooled FULL/COPY-INSERT, bounded exact reuse and failure/visibility behavior.
- **D:** replace the large-to-large retained-extent walk/mapping rebuild with reference-equivalent stored-tree split/concat/coalesce, subtree reuse and a simultaneous finality/memory proof.
- **Qualification:** collect the issue-required matching successful correctness, time, storage and memory evidence. Stage 6 broadens full-core coverage; it does not absorb unfinished #168/#169 gates.

Single-agent order is E, then D, then qualification. Keep existing good implementation and regression fixes. An external run limit requires a precise continuation; it is not a technical blocker or completion. No unrelated feature expansion to accumulate passing tests.

Local documents: `docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/component-decoupling/stages-3-4-continuation-prompt.md` and `stages-3-4-completion-handoff.md`. Some current instructions may be uncommitted; do not assume clean main contains them. The complete continuation prompt is embedded below.

### Stage 4 completion gates (in addition to original Acceptance)

- [ ] **D1:** separately sealed reference oracle and tests distinguishing current byte/canonical validity from exact localized-edit roots/partitions; include 80+100 -> 90+90, untouched siblings, unequal heights and root growth/collapse.
- [ ] **D2:** stored ObjectId+summary versus owned decoded unfinished nodes; actual path-local split/concat/coalesce with the reference partition rules. No full retained-extent enumeration for eligible localized edits.
- [ ] **D3:** emission rules prove that no later admitted edit or join on either side changes an emitted node; bounded simultaneous frontier/read/output ownership; no speculative unreachable output or per-edit tree accumulation.
- [ ] **D4:** exact reference-root/partition, old-root preservation, expected subtree IDs, no-op/transition/multi-edit/failure cases and actual node-work checks through the real C1 and integrated paths.
- [ ] Qualify equivalent successful localized edits with actual work, time, storage and memory evidence; a bounded-memory mapping rebuild does not satisfy this issue.

Keep complete construction for genuine complete input and necessary representation conversion. Remove the large-to-large rebuild route when replaced; no runtime old/new mode or failure fallback. This issue stays open until all original and completion criteria have evidence.

# Continuation prompt: complete the missing Stage 3–4 paths

> **Status:** Proposal; target LayerFS v0.1.7; not a released contract.

Current execution assignment for [#168](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/issues/168)
and [#169](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/issues/169).
Use the [completion handoff](stages-3-4-completion-handoff.md) for detailed algorithms,
ownership and proof gates. The [original handoff](stages-3-4-handoff.md) and
[file/LOC plan](stages-3-4-file-plan.md) retain the full acceptance requirements.
This prompt supersedes the earlier broad execution order, not its requirements.

## Copy/paste assignment

Continue the implementation in:

`/Users/yifanxu/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs`

Complete metadata pooling (checkpoint E), then stored-tree split/concat and finality
(checkpoint D), then their required qualification. Finish both issues' remaining
criteria. Keep the existing payload delta, policy, complete-file, small-file and
transition implementation where correct. Do not restart the refactor or spend this
assignment expanding already-covered features to increase the passing-test count.

### Read and establish the starting state

Read repository/core AGENTS.md, then these files under
`docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/component-decoupling/`:

1. `stages-3-4-completion-handoff.md` — precise remaining assignments/proofs.
2. `stages-3-4-handoff.md` and `stages-3-4-file-plan.md` — full scope and structure.
3. `stages-3-4-report.md` — existing implementation, gaps and declared limitations.
4. `file-content.md`, `physical-encoding-and-packing.md`,
   `admission-and-persistence.md`, `content-storage-policy-and-tables.md`.
5. `stages-3-4-verification.md`, `content-io-memory-audit.md` and the current
   benchmark/release/documentation rules they reference.
6. `stages-3-4-reviewer-handoff.md` — final acceptance and supported-limits audit.

Inspect Git status and current #168/#169 bodies. Planning baseline is `24ef187d4`;
record the actual start commit/tree and relevant uncommitted inputs. Preserve
unrelated changes. Required continuation documents may still be uncommitted;
carry the reviewed rules/documents if using another checkout. A clean main checkout
is not automatically the full assignment. Recount the actual production baseline:
the old file-plan ranges are recommended final sizes, not remaining LOC budgets.

#166/#167 were closed by owner direction; their residual inventory is #174. Do not
reopen that closed scope or turn all of #174 into unrelated prerequisite work.
Preserve its explicit gaps. Where a residual affects this assignment's own required
behavior or measurement, resolve that dependency or report the unmet criterion;
do not reuse its overstated timer split as new evidence.

### Assignment E — implement first, through real persistence

Own C1 `object/inode_leaf.rs` and C2 `encoding/pool/`, `sqlite/pool.rs`, and required
schema/owner/pack/read integration. Supplied canonical leaves are sufficient;
filesystem-tree construction and Workspace integration remain later scope.

1. Implement the exact checked canonical leaf/value grammar, new ordinal assignment,
   value-group body/digest/compression, pooled FULL leaf, catalogue writes and reader.
   Prove real save -> finish -> reopen -> exact canonical bytes/ID.
2. Add reference-equivalent reuse through the bounded Store-owned ordered set:
   first-encounter/smallest-equal ordinals, pending same-save reuse, full-value
   authentication, whole-group window resets, reopen synchronization and failure
   invalidation. Preserve required value groups under reader visibility ceilings.
3. Add pooled COPY/INSERT DELTA, its own depth/work limits and intermediate
   authentication, selected dependencies, atomic persistence and known-owned cleanup.
   This is the existing metadata algorithm; payload PREFIX is not a substitute.

Complete all three steps before moving to D in a single-agent run. A role tag,
empty module/table, framed placeholder or a FULL-only demo does not complete E.
Run `inode_leaf`, `metadata_pool`, `metadata_pool_index` and relevant existing
pack/visibility/failure cases. Add source-backed oracle data outside product src/.
Record implementation and evidence for each step; do not claim #168 complete until
its remaining policy/storage/performance criteria also pass.

### Assignment D — exact tree operations, not mapping reconstruction

Own C1 `file/edit/`, necessary mapping/view changes and external oracle/tests.
Read the pinned v0.1.6 rope edit/state/read/build/codec implementation completely.
The current extent walk plus builder preserves payload IDs but re-derives the
mapping. Replace that large->large route with actual stored-node split/concat.

1. Establish failing external cases against a separately sealed reference oracle:
   exact roots/partitions for 80+100 -> 90+90, affected paths with untouched siblings,
   unequal heights, root growth/collapse and admitted normalized multi-edit sequences.
   Fresh construction or final-byte equality is not a localized-edit root oracle.
2. Implement one private representation of stored subtree ID+summary versus owned
   decoded unfinished entries+summary. Preserve reference split/concat/coalesce,
   partition and root-context rules. Reuse unaffected subtrees where the reference
   does; do not enumerate all retained extents to reconstruct the mapping.
3. For each emission rule, establish why no remaining permitted edit or join on
   either side can alter the node. Prove a hard live-capacity bound covering both
   boundaries, active paths, builder levels, authenticated reads and pending output.
   Emit final children before parents; retain no per-edit tree or speculative output.
4. Replace the mapping-rebuild route once its replacement passes. Keep complete
   construction for actual complete input and required size transitions. No parallel
   runtime mode, error-driven full rebuild or legacy production dependency.

Run the real edit single/batch/model/bounds/no-op/transition/timing cases, exact
reference-root assertions, reachability/old-root tests and observed node-work checks.
Keep a precise counterexample if a rule fails; revise the rule and continue. A
valid canonical tree or bounded heap alone does not complete D.

### Qualification — required before issue closure

Complete the current verification specification with a clearly versioned, committed
addendum before new benchmark implementation/collection. Freeze exact pooling and
localized-edit cases, successful public-operation matching, source/harness/oracle
identities, cache/index state, timing boundaries, numerical/resource limits and
budgets. Existing smoke receipts remain smoke evidence; do not relabel them.

Collect equivalent successful v0.1.6 comparisons where the public surfaces match;
unmatched paths are explicit diagnostics. Report actual time, SQL/transaction/base
reads, node/copy/codec/assembly work, total retained storage/index footprint and
scoped memory observations, with the simultaneous-allocation ledger. Test fixed-size
edits in multiple physically realized tree sizes. No peak-memory claim from capacity
constants alone and no speedup from a faster failure or smaller delta frames alone.

Resolve or explicitly qualify the reported same-save delta-candidate and admitted-FULL
cache deviations against the required selection/storage behavior. Do not quietly
move this assignment's qualification gates into Stage 6.

### Rules, checks and finish

No retry/fallback/fsync/WAL, third-party patches or successful-version rollback.
Retain bounded real CAS/SQL paths, publication visibility, exact authentication and
the Stage 2 pending-group fixes. No Workspace/FUSE/daemon/history dependencies.
Use the existing timer: C1-only, C2-only and integrated calls execute the same bodies;
required reads/waits remain attributed, disabled recording preserves behavior.

Keep external tests and the 999/200 physical-line rules. Run affected checks directly
with the core manifest, locked tests/Clippy, formatting, the boundary guard and its
self-tests, plus the LOC-tool tests if affected. `tools/preflight.sh` is permanently
retired; never run/restore it or add a replacement aggregate wrapper. Respect the
measurement lock, one-sample/worker/cache/budget rules and fresh evidence outputs.

Report exact production LOC before/after/delta per commit, with audited classification
and reference/core/combined subtotals; include runtime SQL and actual-versus-estimated
per-file/directory counts. Publish an additive completion report with separate E,
D and qualification tables, command/evidence links, all gaps, and the reviewer's
limits table for revisions/files/directories/workspaces. Deferred Workspace limits
are not established by an object or batch-size limit.

The assignment is complete only when every remaining #168/#169 criterion is met.
Review the final state with `stages-3-4-reviewer-handoff.md`; close each issue only
with linked actual acceptance evidence. Keep #165 and Stages 5–7 open. Do not
expand unrelated features, lower gates or substitute a partial implementation.

If an external run limit forces interruption, preserve a continuation with exact
source identity, implemented checkpoints, remaining files, failing proof/test and
next concrete action. Resume the same assignment; a run limit is not a technical
blocker or a completed stage. No new agent task is created by this prompt itself.

## Deliverable

Implement independent C1 known edits on immutable bases and real C2 integration, preserving localized work and exact canonical roots. Add small/large/empty transitions, then remove structural overlays only after the decoded unfinished-boundary proof.

## Scope

Use ordered current-result coordinates and stable replayable replacement ranges. Preserve changed-range no-op checks, CDC restart points, split/concat partitions, unchanged extent slices/subtrees and root collapse. Necessary planned comparison and construction reads are not retries; failed I/O terminates the operation.

The reference already streams changed payload chunks. Do not claim removal of a whole-file payload spool on every edit. Target encoded structural overlay/prune/redecode work with bounded owned decoded boundaries and final child-first emission.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Overwrite/insert/delete/append at boundaries and head/middle/tail, repeated edits and no-op results match the reference profile.
- [ ] Small->large, large->small and empty transitions work for every accepted cutoff with sound physical read amplification accounting.
- [ ] Exact root/partition equivalence and frontier finality proven before deleting old structure.
- [ ] Bounded input/base/output/frontier coexistence, slow consumer and late failures covered.
- [ ] C1-only edit and C2-only save timings, plus integrated traces, use the same real algorithms.
- [ ] Existing-or-better qualified localized-edit latency/storage/memory, with no full-store scan, hidden spool, retry or full-rebuild fallback.

Designs: file-content.md, finalized-object-handoff.md, content-io-memory-audit.md. Live Workspace COW and raw FUSE write capture remain later scope.

## Context and design availability

Release tracking: #155. Design discussion: #160. Standalone timer: completed #161. Diff/conflict/resolution is deferred to #164 (v0.2.0).

Reviewed design directory: `docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/component-decoupling/`. Its implementation plan and later owner rules supersede stale retry/checkpoint/durability wording in older design discussion. Some reviewed files are currently local uncommitted changes; do not assume main already contains them. This issue is self-contained about scope; preserve/carry the reviewed specification into the implementation checkout. Creating this issue is not implementation or performance evidence.

## Non-negotiable rules

- No retry, fallback, fsync/fdatasync/sync_all/sync_data, WAL or added crash-durability system. Preserve runtime SQL atomicity/abort with MEMORY journaling, synchronous OFF and zero busy timeout. Unknown acknowledgement is failure; no resend/poll/destructive guess.
- No third-party patches, forks, vendoring or registry edits. Use existing pins and locked builds.
- Production files <=999 physical lines; lib.rs/mod.rs <=200 and declaration/delegation only. Product src has no tests, mocks, fault injection, test-only cfg or test-only public APIs. External tests use real production bodies.
- Core contains the replacement; root crates remain an isolated reference, never a dependency or fallback. C1/C2 do not depend on Workspace, history, FUSE, daemon or Monitor.
- C1-only construction, C2-only real save/read and integrated timing are required, with honest included/excluded work, bounded detail and unchanged on/off behavior. No per-object trace growth or invented duration arithmetic.
- Every commit reports exact production LOC before/after/signed delta with reference/core/combined subtotals. Include shipped runtime SQL; exclude tests/docs/tools. Report estimated-versus-actual size honestly; never remove validation to hit an estimate.
- Preserve actual batching, localized algorithms, locators, useful bounded caches and supported profile semantics. No warm-cache credit, extra workers, hidden spool or fabricated PASS. No CI or aggregate pre-push gate exists. tools/preflight.sh is permanently retired; run explicit affected-workspace checks individually, never an aggregate replacement.

## Stage 4 implementation status (implementer report)

Work is committed through `65f2a402d`. Production LOC over the batch `10415 -> 10929` (content 3907 -> 4385; storage unchanged in this part), reported per commit.

**Implemented and evidenced**

- The whole-mapping rebuild route (`file/edit/frontier.rs`, the streaming plan reader) is **gone**. `file/edit/tree.rs` loads the affected subtree, splits at the edit's boundaries, coalesces, splices, concatenates at equal or unequal height and re-emits only the nodes the new root reaches, with a bounded deferred map that publishes children before parents. Small↔large transitions still rebuild (different page shape); there is no fallback and no second runtime mode.
- **Localization, externally accounted** (`edit_localized`, 5): one three-extent overwrite demands 11 objects at 8 MB and 13 at 24 MB while the mapping grows from 5 to 12 pages; retained payload reads are identical (3) at both sizes; a mid-extent overwrite demands exactly the two boundary extents; an append demands 2 pages and no retained payload; every base payload the edit did not replace is still referenced from the new root; the base still reads its own bytes.
- **Reference equivalence, nine cases** (`edit_reference` against the sealed v0.1.6 `44cf748`): every case matches the reference root, page partition and surviving leaf identities exactly. This includes the newly added `repartition-80-100`, which closes the previously unproven item: the 80-extent and 100-extent fixtures are concatenated, the whole extent run straddling the seam is replaced with the same number of bytes, and the reference repartitions the join to exactly `90 + 90` with the far leaf surviving by identity (`evidence/stages-3-4-oracle-20260917T034500Z/`). The earlier generation's comparison claim stays superseded and on disk.
- Finality, bounded work, late failures and slow consumers: `edit_batch` (7), `edit_bounds` (8), `edit_noop` (7), `edit_model` (6), `edit_transitions` (5), `edit_pipeline` (4); every emitted object is reachable from the returned root and base objects are never rewritten.
- C1-only, C2-only and integrated receipts with timing on/off equivalence: `evidence/stages-3-4-timing-20260917T031000Z/` (C1-only and integrated `small` runs return the same edited root; every product line identical between the on and off runs).

**Open gate — this issue is not complete**

The acceptance item "existing-or-better qualified localized-edit latency/storage/memory" is **INCOMPLETE**. A matched C1 pair now exists and is retained (`evidence/stages-3-4-matched-c1-20260917T050000Z/`): the same 3 300 000-byte base and the same 40 000-byte replacement through the reference `FileMutationBatch` and through the candidate `apply_edits`, two processes that never link each other, all four observations listed in its ledger. It proves the arms return the **identical content-addressed root** `b6dca354…c65207b` in every observation — reference equivalence outside the fixtures — but it does **not** qualify latency: the observations interleave (reference 224 875–351 666 ns, candidate 186 000–468 333 ns), and with one sample per arm neither "existing-or-better" nor "slower" is supported. The byte accounting is not a like-for-like boundary (candidate 7 objects / 47 357 B against reference 5 / 13 826 B, dominated by where the replacement content is emitted), and no memory was instrumented on either side.

Smallest missing case: an owner-approved repeated-sample campaign (n ≥ 5 per arm) on this exact fixture and profile, reporting every sample, plus an aligned byte-accounting boundary; and instrumentation for localized-edit memory.

Full criterion table, LOC and receipts: `docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/component-decoupling/stages-3-4-report.md` and `stages-3-4-final-review.md` (self-review; the independent pass is still open).
